scope: All 23 catalogued RF relations plus Documents stores and relevant external-owner dependencies; not a complete Talli-wide retention inventory

policyClasses.customer_content: After agreed access/export period, return/delete according to documented customer choice. A direct Talli legal duty or lawful instruction requires recorded justification. No blanket five-year Talli right is inferred.
policyClasses.customer_derived_migration_evidence: Company-linked migration evidence remains personal/customer-derived; minimize and review with the customer-content lifecycle, not indefinitely merely because the table is technical.
policyClasses.customer_content_in_technical_store: Quarantine may contain full original personal/customer rows. Attribution and authorized disposition require review; never expose unattributed rows as another company’s export.
policyClasses.operational_configuration: Review operational need and embedded identifiers separately. A table being technical is not proof of anonymization or unlimited retention.

documentsStores.data: Mutable metadata, object key, actor and configured retention_years

documentsStores.data: Cross-capability retention references and source identity
documentsStores.export: RF archive carries its source bindings; complete registry is not portable-exported

documentsStores.data: Immutable metadata generations and actual source/feedback bytes, including earlier years

documentsStores.limitation: Copies may exist before source capture; no automatic retained-copy expiry or physical purge

documentsStores.export: RF referenced originals have inline/streamed immutable copies; general company metadata has object references and missing-object warnings

documentsStores.limitation: Hosted storage backup, rotation and deletion are unverified

openFindings.finding: RF filing_overrides are absent from both canonical RF archive and company-archive input/output
openFindings.next: Add an owner-scoped, versioned export contract and verify override history without widening other filing owners

openFindings.finding: Only authority-test evidence referenced by selected-year simulations is exported
openFindings.next: Decide and implement scoped export of unreferenced customer-owned test evidence; preserve cross-year isolation

openFindings.finding: Migration quarantine and unreferenced retained byte copies exist outside the RF portable bundle
openFindings.next: Provide company-attributed inventory and owner-controlled disposition; never dump unattributed quarantine through customer APIs

openFindings.finding: Cancellation always enters review hold; finalization only records a marker. No documented-choice/access-deadline/hold-expiry/backup-rotation purge is implemented by this lifecycle
openFindings.next: Keep real-customer deletion signoff open; implement through approved owner contracts, not an RF-owned delete or retention policy

openFindings.finding: Original Auth and cluster roles support current local restores; independent recovery, pseudonymization and account-deletion behavior are not established
